reference.title: opend.config.yaml reference
reference.shortdesc: Every field of the project configuration file, with its default and rules.

property.propdesc: The version this branch documents, such as 0.1 or 2.1. The hosted build also requires it to be a version number: its major part is the release line, so 1.4 readers keep getting the 1.x docs after 2.0 is published.
The root map for the site navigation and keys, such as maps/docs.ditamap.
Bookmaps (or maps) published as PDFs. Their file names must be unique, because each is served at /pdf/<file name>.pdf.

The allowed values of each filtering attribute, such as product: [core, hosted, embed]. Keys must be filtering attributes: product, feature, audience, platform, otherprops, props or deliveryTarget. release must not be listed: it takes version ranges. Each value is a single token of letters, digits, _, ., : and -.
A DITAVAL file applied to every reader at build time. See .
A stylesheet loaded after the built-in styles on every page, in the help panel and in PDFs. See .

An image shown before the site title in the page header: an .svg, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif or .webp file. It is drawn 28 pixels high and is decorative, because the title follows it. An SVG logo can carry its own prefers-color-scheme rule for dark mode, as this site's theme/logo.svg does.
How publications print: a built-in template (standard, report, compact or handbook) and any of its settings to change, such as pageSize, cover or footer. See .
The site title in the page header and the PDF cover. Set it to an empty string to use the root map's title instead.

example.title: Example
example.codeblock: title: OpenD Documentation release: '0.1' map: maps/docs.ditamap publications: - maps/admin-guide.bookmap - maps/author-guide.bookmap attributes: product: [core, hosted, embed] feature: [early-access] audience: [author, admin, developer, internal] buildFilter: filters/publish.ditaval theme: theme/site.css logo: theme/logo.svg pdf: template: standard footer: OpenD {release}
example.p: Quote the release. Unquoted, YAML reads 0.1 as a number, and the config is rejected.
Every path must stay inside the docs root: no leading / and no ... Mistakes are reported as invalid-config.
